scope.precision: FP32, autocast disabled, TF32 off, deterministic math SDPA, compiled tiled helpers at rho1/chunks4, no accumulation
scope.fp64: Independent naive FP64 autograd, same stored FP32-representable initial weights and aligned mean-CE fixture; no tiled FP64 claim
scope.excludes: BF16, accumulation, T512, distributed training, CDRM, alternative tasks/configurations and broad statistical guarantees

findings.decision_contribution: CE evidence supports clearing the specifically tested FP32/no-accumulation backward path without a backward patch, provided the final decision retains all failed diagnostic flags and incorporates the independent raw-scaling/write-path and optimizer-sensitivity analyses. This is not an all-criteria-pass claim.
findings.classification: Small coordinate tails from finite-precision end-to-end computation are consistent with the observations: the naive FP32 autograd arm exhibits comparable or larger errors against the FP64 oracle, while all original gradient and relative-L2 bounds pass. This does not prove identical arithmetic or a universal roundoff bound.
